What is Career Education?

Career Education (CE) prepares students for a wide range of high-wage, high skill, high-demand careers. CE is at the forefront of preparing students to succeed in fast-growing, high-growth industries around the country. According to the California Community Colleges Task Force on Workforce Job Creation and a Strong Economy, the labor market is increasingly demanding a more skilled workforce and by 2020 65% of all job openings in the U.S. will require some post-secondary education or training - though not necessarily a four year degree.

It is our mission to provide educational leadership in developing a competitive workforce. For more information on the different Career Education programs that Bakersfield College has to offer visit our Learning & Career Pathways.

Electric Vehicle Program

You may have read about our partnership to create a new technology facility and our intentions of developing a program for developing skills in electronic vehicle technology. We are looking to add classes in addition to our Introduction to Electric Vehicles.

If you are interested in an Electric Vehicle training program, fill out this Electric Vehicle Training Interest Form.

Interested in other types of automotive classes? Check out the Automotive Technology Program.
